name: stacklens-monorepo
description: Function-level call-tree tracing for backends, with a trace analyser UI. SDKs per language under sdks/.

scripts.build: node scripts/dev-guard.mjs && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w stacklens/frontend
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @stacklens/types && npm run build -w @stacklens/node-tracer
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w stacklens/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stacklens/types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist sdks/*/dist stacklens/frontend/.next stacklens/frontend/.next.nosync stacklens/frontend/dist
scripts.conformance:node: npm run build -w @stacklens/node-tracer && node sdks/conformance/node-tracer/run.mjs | node sdks/conformance/check.mjs -
